classification: Synthetic offline verification only; no private configuration, knowledge, scratch, credentials, live model, or Discord service was read or changed.

secondary_disk_after.cold_definition: Fresh graph query caches after constructor; database/OS page caches may be warm after preparation, backup and startup. No OS-cold measurement is claimed.
secondary_disk_after.connection_facade: Only the main harness's sqlite3 binding is replaced by an explicit named-file connect facade; memory implementation and real sqlite3 module are unmodified. Primary harness bytes/hash were preserved.

old_before.comparability: The old baseline includes active full-graph shadow observation; the approved new static path disables shadow writes. Old baseline read-freeze excludes observation scratch disk writes. One old sample is context, not a robust speedup distribution; Python3.14 values must not be compared by relative percentages with Python3.12 after values.

byte_comparison.oracle: Exact db04135 full edge decoder/selection, reading identical frozen source and dynamic SQLite state, without invoking old _observe.
byte_comparison.preserved: Complete returned record bytes, literal/direct-hit match bytes, every related edge statistic, all accepted/rejected expansion decisions, rank order, selected provenance and evidence fields, including stored dynamic scores/event IDs.
byte_comparison.projection: Filter old edge statistics to direct-hit incident edges and old frequencies to those edge endpoints; remove only explicit scope marker fields. Global active-record/live-edge scalars remain byte-compared. Neither ranking nor evidence fields are normalized or dropped.
byte_comparison.audit_change: New schema2 declares audit_scope=direct_hit_neighborhood_v1 and endpoint-only mark-frequency scope. Static events do not seed, decay or reinforce shadow. Full audit envelopes and durable hashes intentionally differ; no whole-package byte-equivalence claim is made.
byte_comparison.nonzero_history_unit_test: tests/test_subgraph_byte_identity.py additionally verifies nonzero retained legacy dynamic history is read exactly and never changed by static queries, plus source add/retirement refresh.

timing_boundaries.actual_5_second_local_cap: retrieve + CanonicalSnapshot + actual synthetic ScratchLog.write_snapshot(memory_observation) with flush/fsync + freeze_retrieval, matching Runtime.process through its local-cap check.
timing_boundaries.old_harness_compatible_read_freeze: retrieve + CanonicalSnapshot + freeze_retrieval, excluding the observation scratch disk write.
timing_boundaries.complete_records_and_validation: Actual local-cap path plus independent validate_graph_audit and the post-cap retrieval_record/knowledge_retrieved scratch writes with flush/fsync.
timing_boundaries.not_query_time: Ingestion/NPMI publication, database backup, constructor validation, scratch startup and old frozen oracle work are untimed. Startup and ingestion remain global costs and may exceed5seconds.
timing_boundaries.instrumentation: SQL trace and VM progress callbacks every100 instructions are included in query timing. VM callback count is a coarse work measure, not a claim that SQLite tree seeks are mathematically O(1).

limits: All63 final synthetic samples satisfied the measured5second local-cap boundary. Finite in-memory/disk curves do not prove arbitrary-size or live-service deadlines, OS-cold behavior, recall quality, semantic support, or linear cost in local edge count. Complete local contexts/evidence repeat per ranked candidate: growing-star audit bytes are503262/2527608/20444059, so local output cost can grow faster than edge count. Interrupted/source-drift preliminary runs were not saved as final after reports. No running instance was restarted or hot-updated.
